caption: The drawing depicts a spinning wheel, rendered in shades of brown with fine detailing to mimic the appearance of wood. The spinning wheel has a large circular wheel with multiple spokes mounted vertically on a rectangular base. There are two pairs of curved legs attached to the front and back of the base, giving the structure stability. At the bottom center of the base, a foot pedal is attached, shaped with a gentle curve and mounted with braces. Above the main wheel, there is a horizontal platform with several turned wooden posts that support additional smaller components such as the flyer, bobbin, and whorl, which are intricately drawn with varying heights and rounded shapes. The entire object is positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background, with the lines and shadows suggesting a realistic style of illustration.
title: Wood Spinning Wheel
